facts.fact: The law firm Haymanot & Advocates says Directive SBB/94/2025 makes transfers abroad of non-customer data by banks conditional on National Bank of Ethiopia prior written approval, disclosure of destinations, adequate protection in the receiving jurisdiction and service level agreements.

The same source says Proclamation No. 1321/2024 permits transfers of personal data abroad only where the receiving country gives appropriate protection, the person consents explicitly, or the authority approves in advance.
